subject: Factoryline procurement: provisional PO issuance, spend band and SKU mapping
body:
From: Amy Chen <amy.chen@factoryline.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@factoryline.com
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding form + provisional PO request (Factoryline)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the walkthrough today. Attached is the completed onboarding form and our SKU list. We need a provisional PO number to start provisioning access and to lock a spend band while our legal finishes the SOW. Can you confirm the provisional PO value we can expect? We expect initial spend will be $75k over three months, with two line items: "Inference GPU hours" and "Data egress credits".

Attachments: Factoryline_Onboarding_Form.pdf, FL_PO_Line_Mapping.csv

Best,
Amy Chen
Head of Procurement
Factoryline Manufacturing

----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@factoryline.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding form + provisional PO request (Factoryline)

Thanks Amy — got the form and the SKU list. Looping in Priyom from procurement to issue a provisional PO / spend band. Priyom: can you issue a provisional PO for $75,000 with two lines as requested? Also noting Factoryline wants a 3-month spend cap; if we need a different spend band style please advise.

Action items:
- Priyom: provisional PO number + any required PO reference for the vendor portal (target: 48h)
- Amy: confirm the internal billing contact and if FL needs the PO split by region (they do not).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

----
From: Priyom Das <priypom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Amy Chen <amy.chen@factoryline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding form + provisional PO request (Factoryline)

Thanks — quick procurement check before we issue:
1) Line-item granularity: The CSV lists "Inference GPU hours" as two separate SKUs (gpu-prod and gpu-burst). We prefer a single consolidated line for invoice clarity unless they require separate ledger codes. If FX needs split accounting, we can keep them separate but need exact qty and unit rates.
2) Data egress: the mapping file has three egress buckets. Our PO template supports up to two lines for credits; please confirm which two buckets FL intends to prepay.
3) Currency & tax: confirm USD and whether prices include VAT (Factoryline is US-based so VAT not expected).
4) Attachments: please fill sections A & B on our PO_Tracker_Template.xlsx (I attached an empty template). We need the vendor's remit-to and billing contact for the final PO.

If we get the consolidated SKU mapping and the completed tracker we can issue a provisional PO (PROV-2026-1309) for $75,000 today, with the following constraints: spend band $0-$75,000, auto-escalation disabled until legal signs SOW, and temporary cap expiry 90 days from issue.

Provisional PO draft (will change if they request splits):
- PROV-2026-1309 — Factoryline Manufacturing — $75,000 — Lines: Inference GPU hours (consolidated), Data egress credits (bucket A + B)

Please confirm the SKU consolidation and I will publish the provisional PO.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Procurement Lead — Redwood Inference

----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@factoryline.com>, Priyom Das <priypom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Onboarding form + provisional PO request (Factoryline)

Amy — copying the consolidated mapping you provided and the completed tracker (see attached FL_PO_Line_Mapping.csv and the tracker). We consolidated the two GPU SKUs into one line called "Inference GPU compute" at your request and combined egress buckets B and C into a single "Egress credits" line. Priyom: updated unit rates are in the CSV, totals roll up to $75,000.

Amy, please confirm the billing contact: Sandra Lopez (sandra.lopez@factoryline.com) and confirm USD pricing. If you confirm, Priyom will issue PROV-2026-1309 today and I will share the provisional PO number and the tracker link.

Thanks all — short timeline this week would be great so infra can start provisioning.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

----
(attachments referenced: Factoryline_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf), FL_PO_Line_Mapping.csv (csv), PO_Tracker_Template.xlsx (xlsx))
